'''Lavender treebread''' was a type of [[Bread/Legends|bread]] that was [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolans]].<ref name="TFJP" /> Around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">Lavender treebread's mention in "[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]" takes place a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the part of the story that is concurrent with {{Film|VI}}, the events of which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> the Ortolan [[Music/Legends|musician]] [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]] was excited as he anticipated eating lavender treebread at dinner; however, he ultimately did not receive the dinner and did not eat any of the bread.<ref name="TFJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lavender treebread was mentioned in "[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]," a short story written by [[John Gregory Betancourt]] and published in the ''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]'' story collection in [[1995]].<ref name="TFJP" />
